name: @pipeworx/mcp-numbers

tools.name: convert_base
tools.description: Convert an integer between numeral bases 2-36 (keyless, offline). E.g. number "ff" from_base 16 to_base 2 -> "11111111".

number.description: The number as a string in `from_base`.

tools.name: to_roman
tools.description: Convert an integer (1-3999) to Roman numerals.

tools.name: from_roman
tools.description: Convert a Roman numeral to an integer (rejects malformed numerals).

tools.name: number_to_words
tools.description: Spell an integer in English words, e.g. 1234 -> "one thousand two hundred thirty-four".

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-numbers forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the numbers pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
